title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.14844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. translated_title: AutoAssumption：通过在假设空间上搜索来发现机器学习系统算法
translated_abstract: 机器学习系统的许多进展都来自于打破早期方法习以为常的假设：例如投机解码抛弃了“模型每生成一个 token 都需要一次前向传播”这一假设。然而，算法很少显式陈述其假设，因此专家和自动发现框架只能在程序层面进行搜索，其中一次修改会同时改变多个设计选择，收益也难以归因。而在假设本身上进行搜索的思路在很大程度上仍未被探索。将算法写成证明的形式可以使其假设显式化，并将算法设计转化为在一个小型、结构化空间中的搜索，这个空间既可以由大语言模型探索，也可以由证明检查器进行审计。我们将来自 KV 缓存驱逐、权重剪枝和投机解码的 89 个算法形式化为带有显式假设的证明图，并在 Lean 中进行检查验证。我们的框架 AutoAssumption 会放宽某个已发表方法的一个假设，重新推导并重新证明该算法，然后生成其代码。在 KV 缓存驱逐和权重剪枝（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出将机器学习系统算法表示为带显式假设的 Lean 证明图，并构建 AutoAssumption 框架，让大语言模型自动放宽已发表算法的某个假设、重新推导证明并生成代码，从而把算法发现转化为在结构化假设空间上的自动搜索。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes 89 ML-systems algorithms as Lean-checked proof graphs with explicit assumptions and introduces AutoAssumption, an LLM-driven harness that automatically relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves the algorithm, and generates its code.
